prompt: A beach scene with vacationers and activities. A lifeguard is sitting on a tall chair, watching swimmers in the ocean and holding binoculars. The lifeguard appears stronger and focused than the relaxed beach vendor. The lifeguard is pointing at a surfer riding a wave further out. A family is building a sandcastle with three towers on the beach. The father is digging while the mother shapes the castle walls. Their child has a number of buckets, which is one less than the number of towers, and is carrying one to the construction site. A beach vendor is walking along the shore, pulling a cooler behind him. The cooler contains two cold drinks and a number of ice cream bars. The number of ice cream bars is three times the number of cold drinks. A seagull is flying overhead, diving toward a picnic basket that a couple has left unattended. The couple is swimming in the ocean; the woman is floating on an inflatable raft while the man is diving underwater. A beach umbrella is planted in the sand next to a towel.
